bio: Grove of Narberth, one of the finest country house hotels in Wales, is the setting for the Fernery, a nature-inspired restaurant that brings the outside in. It’s a proudly Welsh place, with a tasting menu (available in two lengths) that showcases the best produce the locale has to offer, including ingredients from their own gardens. Dishes come with incredible levels of detail that belie the understated, somewhat cryptic menu descriptions such as 'Walled Garden'. The superb service ensures your experience unfolds flawlessly....
